pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, multi-pointed star-like geometry with high edge angularity. Individual dark regions exhibit sharp pixel gradients at the periphery with jagged, non-linear boundaries across the flank and neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light cream-colored negative space forming a continuous topological graph. Junction nodes predominantly feature tri-axial and quadri-axial intersections. Pathway thickness is non-uniform, showing increased pixel width on the lower flank near the ventral midline.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, dark mane along the neck and shoulder ridge presenting a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged contour against the background foliage.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive radiate textural transition at patch edges where dark hairs interdigitate with light corridors, creating a feathered high-contrast border.
